Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

Most damage to a collection is caused by light, damp, pests and handling, and much of it can be prevented at little cost. A conservator shows how to assess, store and handle paper, textiles and metal, with practice on sample materials.

All materials are provided. The session is adapted to your space, your timetable and the age of the participants.

What it covers

  • What damages a collection: light, damp, pests and handling
  • Assessing the condition of an object
  • Storing and handling paper, textiles and metal
  • Practice on sample materials

How the time is spent

  1. Risks 35 min

    Light, heat, humidity, pests, movement.

    You: risk map

  2. Dummy handling 110 min

    Practice supports and labels on replicas.

    You: handling checklist

  3. Prevention 35 min

    Environmental monitoring and escalation.

    You: care plan

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify the main causes of damage to a collection: light, damp, pests and handling.
  • Assess the condition of an object made of paper, textile or metal.
  • Plan safe storage and handling for paper, textiles and metal, including environmental monitoring.
